How the value is calculated

  1. No earnings yet: value comes from the feasibility study – the after-tax NPV at several metal prices.
  2. Read the NPV at today's metal price (straight line between the study's cases), × ownership.
  3. Add cash, subtract debt, divide by shares = NAV per share. The study NPV is a ceiling, not a floor.
  4. Rule: BUY ≤ 0.8× NAV, WATCH ≤ 1.0×, HOLD ≤ 1.5×, SELL above.
Worked example: price C$10.78 ÷ NAV C$19.19 = 0.56× NAV; buy at or below C$15.35.

How the value is calculated

  1. Owner earnings = adjusted net income + D&A − sustaining capex, × periods a year.
  2. Re-price to today's metals: ounces / pounds sold × (spot − realised price) × (1 − royalty) × (1 − tax).
  3. Value = owner earnings × 12 (cautious) and × 15 (fair), plus net cash per share.
  4. Rule (tier A): start a position at or below the 15x value, add at or below 12x; AISC ≤ 60% of spot.
Worked example: (1,324 + 457 − 296) × 4 ÷ 505.5m shares = $11.75 a share; re-priced to today's metals −1.54 → $10.21. × 12 + $6.76 net cash = $129.28 (cautious); × 15 = $159.91 (fair). Price $178.41.

How the value is calculated

  1. Not owner earnings: the value is in data centres being built under long leases, valued on the cash they hand to shareholders once finished.
  2. Pay the bonds first: net operating income − interest − bond repayments − tax = cash to shareholders.
  3. Discount at the return you want (cautious / base / fair), add the sites' value when the leases end, then add bitcoin, cash and the rest of the business, minus other debt.
  4. Rule on the cautious value: BUY ≤ 0.8×, WATCH ≤ 1.0×, HOLD ≤ 1.5×, SELL above.
Values: cautious $36.71, base $52.12, fair $70.13 a share against $61.97 = 1.69× the cautious value.

Assumptions and data notes

  • River Bend NOI = $7.0bn ÷ 15 years; Beacon Point Phase 1 = company campus NOI $1.3bn − Phase 2 $655m. NOI ≈ rent because the leases are triple-net.
  • Phase 1 lease assumed to run to 2042 (bond maturity). Construction-period interest assumed paid from the restricted proceeds, so no equity is needed for River Bend or Phase 1, as management says.
  • Phase 2: $5.0bn cost (85% debt, 15% equity = $750m from Hut 8) is an assumption from the Phase 1 bond size; management has not given cost or terms.
  • Tax 21% on NOI less interest and 15-year straight-line depreciation; loss carry-forwards and bonus depreciation would lower it (upside).
  • American Bitcoin: only its bitcoin is counted, not its mining business or debt. Rest of the business at 3–7x the adjusted EBITDA run-rate.
  • Price $52.65 is the 6 Nov 2026 close per Morningstar; earlier sources conflict ($48.46 intraday 6 Nov, $45.95 close 5 Nov, $63.75 cited for 4 Nov).
  • Tenant quality is the strongest point: a Google backstop at River Bend and an AA- or better tenant at Beacon Point, so the main risk is delivery, not payment.
  • Watch-list dates: 10 Dec 2026 (audit result for Beacon Point's Texas baseload classification) and 17 Dec (expected final classification) – both gate Phase 2 financing.
  • Volatility is extreme (beta above 4): closes moved from about $76 (15 Oct) to $46 (5 Nov). Size any options small.
  • Morningstar's quantitative model (7 Nov) gives $70.74 fair value / 5 stars, but it does not model the leases and reads the restricted construction cash as low leverage.

How the value is calculated

  1. Owner earnings = adjusted net income (royalty and streaming companies have no meaningful capex), × periods a year.
  2. Re-price to today's metals: ounces / pounds sold × (spot − realised price) × (1 − royalty) × (1 − tax).
  3. Value = owner earnings × 12 (cautious) and × 15 (fair), plus net cash per share.
  4. Rule (tier A): start a position at or below the 15x value, add at or below 12x; AISC ≤ 60% of spot.
Worked example: (410) × 4 ÷ 455.0m shares = $3.60 a share; re-priced to today's metals −0.92 → $2.69. × 12 − $3.20 net debt = $29.04 (cautious); × 15 = $37.10 (fair). Price $131.80.
